# Tagcast 1.9.9

## Play from your saved queue sooner

Open Tagcast and press **Play** in your restored queue while the album overview is still loading. Tagcast checks your saved library in the background and keeps the current track playing when the updated albums appear. The queue opens paused. First-time users and profiles without a usable saved library still need to load their library online.

## Earlier playback for Original FLAC albums

With **Original file (Premium)** and **Gapless playback for albums in order** enabled under **Settings → Playback**, choose **Play album** on a FLAC album. Track 1 can start as soon as the first group of audio frames passes its checks, while Tagcast downloads the rest. A short intro can still wait for the next track so the music flows through the transition.

In an Electron test on Apple Silicon, the first track played while the test server held back half the file. Across three synthetic tracks, all 631,301 stereo sample frames matched the uninterrupted reference, including both transitions.
